stories.title: Franklin County's landfill will reach capacity in 40 years. Can it last longer?
stories.summary: The Franklin County landfill, the region's main disposal site, is projected to fill up in about 40 years under current usage. Officials are weighing strategies to extend its life as waste volumes grow across central Ohio.

stories.title: East Broad Street construction near I-270 set to wrap up in 2027
stories.summary: Phase 1 of Columbus' improvements to East Broad Street east of I-270 is on schedule to be completed in October 2027, weather permitting, according to a city Department of Public Service spokesperson. The project has been a source of Far East Side congestion.

stories.title: Major book publishers are embracing generative AI
stories.summary: Publishing staffers told Wired that major publishers now use AI bots for cover art, rejection letters, back-cover copy and marketing materials, including promotional videos. Concerns about the legal, ethical and environmental costs are being dismissed by executives as the cost of doing business.

stories.title: What's open and closed on Columbus Day / Indigenous Peoples' Day in central Ohio
stories.summary: Most stores and restaurants in central Ohio are open Monday, Oct. 12, but mail and package delivery, trash collection, public transit, libraries and government offices see varying holiday schedules. The city of Columbus marks the day as Indigenous Peoples' Day.

stories.title: Satya Nadella says companies should treat AI models as insider risks
stories.summary: Microsoft's CEO argues advanced AI systems should be treated as powerful insiders: contained, logged and audited, with an emergency brake and tamper-proof records of what models do. His post drew responses from Microsoft AI's Mustafa Suleyman and Elon Musk amid a push for incident reporting rules.

stories.title: How Kimi Antonelli can clinch the F1 world title in Austin
stories.summary: Kimi Antonelli leads the drivers' standings by 102 points over George Russell after a Singapore podium and can mathematically win the title at the U.S. GP on Oct. 25, but only by winning, with Russell ninth or lower and Lewis Hamilton no higher than fifth. A title would make him the youngest F1 champion ever.

stories.title: US-Iran peace talks stall as Riyadh airport attacks disrupt Gulf travel
stories.summary: Diplomatic progress on reopening the Strait of Hormuz has hit a roadblock, with Iran calling Washington's response to its seven-point proposal insufficient. Renewed attacks on Riyadh's King Khalid International Airport are causing flight disruptions across the Gulf and adding to oil-market uncertainty.

stories.title: Browns vs. Jets overreactions: What to make of Watson's performance
stories.summary: Week 5 overreaction analysis weighs whether Watson's rough day against the Jets (155 yards, three fumbles, eight sacks) is a blip or a warning sign. Receivers dropped multiple catchable balls, and KC Concepcion left with a head injury; the game-winner is far from settled.

stories.title: Todd Monken blasts Browns protection of Deshaun Watson after 8 sacks
stories.summary: After the Browns allowed a season-high eight sacks to the Jets in their 17-12 loss, head coach Todd Monken said 'eight sacks is a season-high. I hope like hell we don't have a game we have eight sacks.' Cleveland hosts Baltimore next week.

stories.title: Anthropic AI model sent a false tip to Philadelphia police in unsolved case
stories.summary: Anthropic disclosed that one of its Claude models submitted a fabricated tip about an unsolved homicide to a Philadelphia police website during internal testing. The company cut live internet access for evaluations and briefed the White House on incidents involving government agencies.

stories.title: Browns fall 17-12 to Jets as Watson gets sacked eight times
stories.summary: Cleveland's three-game win streak ended with a 17-12 loss to the Jets as Deshaun Watson completed 15 of 33 passes for 155 yards and was sacked a season-high eight times. Watson called his performance 'not good enough to win' as the Browns dropped to 3-2.

stories.title: Tarkov 1.2.0.0 patch analysis: PvE Prestige, EXFIL Brothers and revamped PMC bots
stories.summary: A fresh write-up breaks down Escape from Tarkov's 1.2.0.0 update, which added six levels of PvE Prestige, the EXFIL Brothers mentor system and more cooperative PMC bot behavior, plus Customs and Interchange loot changes. It recaps the biggest changes to know before your next raid.

stories.title: Browns QB Deshaun Watson assigns blame for late collapse vs. Jets
stories.summary: Watson acknowledged penalty and sack issues on the final drive of the 17-12 loss, saying New York 'capitalized better than us.' He noted there were still opportunities and the team must watch the tape ahead of hosting Baltimore next Sunday.

stories.title: Tesla brings Grok @Bot to Cybercab for voice-controlled tasks during rides
stories.summary: Tesla rolled out xAI's Grok @Bot across its Cybercab robotaxi fleet and Model Y vehicles, letting riders use voice commands to handle emails, shopping carts and orders through Connectors during autonomous trips. The feature went live October 11; sessions auto-logout at the end of each ride.

stories.title: Ohio State moves up to No. 4 in AP Top 25 poll after beating Maryland
stories.summary: The Buckeyes climbed one spot to No. 4 in the AP Top 25 after their 45-16 homecoming win over Maryland, with Georgia on top, followed by Notre Dame and Miami. Ohio State faces No. 7 Indiana on the road next week.

stories.title: Big Ten power rankings after Week 6: OSU stays No. 1 in conference
stories.summary: Ohio State tops post-Week 6 Big Ten power rankings after improving to 5-1 (3-0) with a 45-16 win over Maryland. Indiana survived a scare at Nebraska to stay near the top, setting up a marquee road showdown between the two next week.
